card.name: Warning symptoms patients should report
card.fires_on: Words inside instructions to watch for or report warning symptoms, such as 'if they experience', 'abdominal pain', or lists of symptoms after 'e.g.,'. It fires where a symptom is about to be named or is just being named.

modes.label: Report-if lead-in
modes.description: Pronoun or verb in 'contact their physician if they experience' before a symptom list.
modes.example: Patients should be advised to contact their physician if<< they>> experience any indication of infection such as fever

modes.description: Symptom nouns like pain or breath, or commas in symptom lists, within monitoring or counseling advice.
